'''Titles''' ---- '''Titles''', sometimes referred to as '''Flairs''', are tags that float above the player's nickname. Players can change their '''Titles''' in the inventory menu or in [[Rewards]], though [[Rewards]] only allows achievement '''Titles''' to be applied. It is possible to disable '''Title''' visibility for you, and the others in the settings, by toggling the"''Show Flair''" setting. Certain '''Titles''' also have additional cosmetic functions, such as a broader range of colors on them. '''Titles''' are currently earned through [[Index#Achievements|Achievements]], which are accessible from the [[Index]] menu button in the lobby or by having a rank in the [[Paradoxum Games]] group higher than the regular member. ==Current Titles==

==Trivia== *The ''Default'' '''Title''' is unique as, unlike the other '''Titles''', it is not something you can actually obtain. **''Default'' is a fault in the game logic where it makes the user wear a nonexistent '''Title''' called ''Default''. **This is different from other default items, which are generally given for free. **As ''Default'' can only be obtained when a '''Title''' is removed from a player's inventory, the only way to realistically get it is to be demoted from a rank in the Paradoxum Games group while wearing the '''Title''' from that rank. *The ''First Contact'' '''Title''' likely references the main theme of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]'s [[Rotfield|first night]], which shares the same name. *The ''Slayer'' '''Title''' is likely a reference to the '''Back From Infernal''' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]], which also involves beating an insane map on [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode, with the reward being the {{Color|Mission|Slayer}} skin for [[Shotgunner]]. *The ''Cursed Soul'' '''Title''' is a reference to the [[Pizza Party]]'s [[Lost Souls]], and likely also refers to the whole map being cursed in general. *The ''Usurper'' '''Title''' references the defeat of the [[Fallen King]] in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, due to an Usurper being a person who takes a position of power or importance illegally or by force. *The ''Buckshot'' '''Title''' may be a reference to Buckshot Roberts, who was an American [[Cowboy]]. *The ''Paladin'' '''Title''' is a reference to twelve legendary knights who were the foremost members of Charlemagne's court in the 8th century. **The term ''paladin'' is from Old French, deriving from the Latin ''comes palatinus'' (count palatine), a title given to close retainers. *The ''Scorched Earth'' '''Title''' is a reference to a military strategy of the same name, in which a group of soldiers destroy properties and resources so that an invading enemy force cannot make use of it. *The ''Sentinel'' '''Title''' is a reference to a soldier or guard whose job is to stand and keep watch, which is likely related to [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode having medieval enemies, such as the [[Fallen Squire]]. *The ''Ascended'' '''Title''' may be referencing how the [[Fallen King]] undergoes ascension into its [[Awakened Fallen King|awakened]] form after being defeated. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''10 July 2019'''
